# Expected failures for sigstore-conformance's pytest node names.

# literal "[" in pytest's parametrized node name. The second field is the
# deliberate DESIGN.md scope decision; keep one line per failing test node.

# Source suite revision used for this list:
# sigstore/sigstore-conformance @ f12aa02f4a6e5a9e84bcc3c10c193b14ab04da9d

# Managed keys: the protocol's --key verification flow is outside this
# certificate/Fulcio/GitHub-policy crate.

test_verify[[]DIGEST-managed-key-and-trusted-root]	DESIGN: key-based cosign/managed-key verification is a non-goal; the client supports certificate-identity verification only.
